title: bl_authority.command_words puts the option text of a gate's do dict back into the text strict_signals and class_reasons read, so the word-list and backticked-class-name blanking never applies to a gate that carries do
goal: bl_authority.command_words reads the values of a gate's do dict (the argv or item id each option runs) and not its option-text keys, so a gate with do whose question or options quote paid as a word list or a gate class name in backticks is read as strict_signals and class_reasons read the same gate without do

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_authority as a;o="paying: pay, paid, spend, charge";c="give class " + chr(96) + "secrets" + chr(96) + ", " + chr(96) + "push" + chr(96) + " or " + chr(96) + "delete" + chr(96);g={"question":"Which words does PRICE_ASK read as a paying cue?","options":[o,"x"],"do":{o:"BG-aaaaaaaa","x":"BG-aaaaaaaa"}};h={"id":"g1","question":"Which phrase does the eval row expect?","options":[c],"do":{c:"BG-aaaaaaaa"}};k=a.class_reasons({"touches":["kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv"],"title":"an eval row"},h)[0];m=[s for s in a.strict_signals(g) if s[0]=="money"];print(m,k);sys.exit(1 if m or k in ("secrets","delete","push") else 0)
